title: 2026 Highlight Zone Preview: Northrop Bruins - NewsBreak
text:
By Josh Ayen ,
3 hours ago
FORT WAYNE, Ind. (WANE) – Coming off a turnaround season last fall, the Bruins hope another special season is brewing at Spuller Stadium.
Northrop is coming off an 8-3 season, their highest win total since 2003.
John Schaefer is now tasked with sustaining Northrop’s success as the new head coach. Schaefer previously served on Quentin Bowen’s coaching staff.
The cupboard is not bare for Schaefer as he settles in as head coach. Northrop features plenty of offensive firepower, including Division I recruit Maddox Weil. The speedy wideout caught 58 passes for 968 yards and eight touchdowns as a sophomore. Jaxson Robinson, Robert Rembert IV and incoming freshman Jaydin Haller are also expected to shine in Northrop’s receiver corps. Kobe Reese and Levi Portee also return for the senior season. The duo rushed for seven touchdowns apiece last fall.
As for the quarterback position, Jaelin Jackson and Carroll transfer Brayden Peppler are battling for the starting job. Whoever wins that competition will have an abundance of playmakers at his disposal.
Northrop also boasts some of the most talented linemen in Fort Wayne with Ifeanyi Emedobi and Camden Day. Emedobi is committed to play at the University of Michigan, despite only playing one full season of football. Day, a defensive tackle, committed to Kent State over the summer.
Northrop kicks off their season on Friday, Aug 21 against Gary West.
